DML.SELECT: SELECT delayed_incident_report_id as "delayedIncidentReportId", stretch_id as "stretchId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_delayed_incident_report_affection_stretchs WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_delayed_incident_report_affection_stretchs (delayed_incident_report_id, stretch_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:delayedIncidentReportId , :stretchId , :enabled , :visible , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_delayed_incident_report_affection_stretchs WHERE delayed_incident_report_id = :delayedIncidentReportId AND stretch_id = :stretchId
